resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-orders container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-orders container, in MB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-orders container, in MB

deployment.description: mod-orders is stateless (aside from Kafka consumer group coordination) and supports horizontal scaling / multiple replicas for HA. Adjust replicas based on expected order-processing and receiving load.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-orders composite-order, receiving and rollover endpoints. Use this only if different from default Kong configuration.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum PostgreSQL connection pool size for mod-orders

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Threshold in milliseconds above which query execution plans are logged for slow-query analysis

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Kafka topic replication factor used when mod-orders creates its producer topics on tenant init

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Scope of tenants for which the Kafka producer is initialized (e.g. ALL, or a specific tenant collection)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for general order-events Kafka consumers

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONTRIBUTOR_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for contributor-related Kafka event processing

EnvVars.name: DI_ORDER_CREATED_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions for the DI_ORDER_CREATED Kafka topic created during data-import order processing

EnvVars.name: DI_ORDER_CREATED_READY_FOR_POST_PROCESSING_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions for the DI_ORDER_CREATED_READY_FOR_POST_PROCESSING Kafka topic used during data-import post-processing

EnvVars.name: DI_PENDING_ORDER_CREATED_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions for the DI_PENDING_ORDER_CREATED Kafka topic used during data-import for pending orders

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier, also used as the Kafka environment/topic-naming prefix

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-orders process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Defines if the mod-orders system user must be created/used at tenant initialization for internal (data-import) service requests
